items.title: Not 10p! 🖊️ Riddle #15 Answer + Riddle #16: Two Coins, 30p 🪙 #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday, a pen and a notebook cost £1.10, the notebook costs £1 more than the pen.  Most people say £10, but then the notebook is £1.10, and the total is £1.20.  The pen costs £5, the notebook £1.05, together £1.10, now a brand new mystery.  Person 1 shows two coins, together they are worth £30.  Person 2 looks closely and says one of them is not a £10 coin.  Person 3 shouts, that is impossible, or is it?  So which two coins does Person 1 have?  Comment your answer, the answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.
qa.second_check_notes: Fresh-subagent review: #15 answer 5p correct (£1.05 + 5p = £1.10, gap £1); #16 well-posed, one sensible answer (20p + 10p: the 20p is the coin that is not a 10p; no 15p/25p coins in the UK), answer not revealed; no salam, Person 1/2/3 only, solution first then new riddle, HUD and vote ending; street-lamp glow not behind any head. 'pence' confirmed in the final mix by a separate whisper pass (full transcript formats amounts as £).

items.title: Sab Se Behtar Kaun? Daulat Nahin, Ohda Nahin… | Sahih Bukhari 5027 #shorts

qa.heard: تم میں سب سے بہتر کون ہے؟ جواب سن کر آپ حران رہ جائیں گے  حضرت اسمانِ ونی رزی اللہ آن ہو  ریوایت ہے کہ ہمارے نبی محمد مصطفہ سل اللہ تعالی علیہ وعا علیہ وسلم نے فرمایا  تم میں سب سے بہتر وہ ہے جو قرآن سیکھے اور دوسروں کو سکھائے  دولت نہیں حدا نہیں  بلکہ قرآن today ایک آئیت خوب بھی سیکھیں اور ایک آئیت اپنے بچوں کو سکھائیں  کمت میں لکیں انشاء اللہ یہ ویڈیو آگے بھیجیں یہ بھی ایک اور سد کا ہے

items.title: Muddy Hands? Let's Get Clean! 🧼 Cleanliness Is Half of Faith | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.heard: Oh no! Muddy hands after playing outside. What do we do?  Listen, our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa,  sallallahu ta'ala alaihi wa a'ala alihi wa sallam  One said, cleanliness is half of faith.  Wow! So let's get clean. Wash your hands with soap.  Bubbles everywhere. Brush your teeth up and down until they sparkle.  Comb your hair and put on clean clothes.  Allah loves those who keep clean and everyone loves a fresh clean hug.  What will you keep clean today?  Tell your grown-up.
